name: Piazza-Desktop-Agent
goal: Build the later online desktop operator/workspace client without turning it into a local execution host.
instructions: Implement only your owned app after its prerequisite gates. Update shared contracts before payload or route changes.
Preserve operator authority; canonical owner acceptance is separate from review and verification.
Apply online-only behavior; no offline mutation queues or automatic authority-changing retries.
Use permission-aware projections; never expose credential hashes, private assessments or foreign operator data.
Start after core web flows are verified; reuse contracts/design, not another apps mutable source tree.
No arbitrary filesystem, shell, external navigation or generic IPC proxy.
Use an OS-native secure credential backend and fail closed if unavailable; never plaintext fallback.
Resolve supported OS, signing/update distribution and supported Electron version against official docs before implementation.

technical_constraints.shell: Electron main/preload/renderer separation; sandbox, contextIsolation, nodeIntegration off
technical_constraints.secrets: OS credential store via narrow typed bridge; renderer keeps access token in memory
technical_constraints.targets: Open owner decision; native signed artifacts for selected systems
technical_constraints.offline: No offline DB, sync queue or automatic reconnect mutation
